description: FBA stock for one seller SKU in one marketplace, from the FBA Inventory API. Upserted on sync; unique on (connection, marketplace, seller_sku).

fields.label: Connection
fields.description: Which seller's stock this is. Part of the row key, so two sellers with the same SKU on one bench keep separate rows.

fields.label: Fulfillable
fields.description: In a fulfilment centre and sellable today. The only figure that is stock for a reorder decision — see spapi/inventory.py.

fields.label: Reserved
fields.description: Physically present, already allocated to placed orders.

fields.label: Unfulfillable
fields.description: Damaged, expired or otherwise never sellable again. Counted in Total, never in cover.

fields.label: Researching
fields.description: Amazon has lost track of these and is looking for them.

fields.label: Inbound (total)
fields.description: Working + shipped + receiving. Bought, not yet sellable: counting it as cover is how a seller stocks out while the dashboard still shows days in hand.

fields.label: Total (Amazon's)
fields.description: Amazon's own sum across every bucket above, including unfulfillable. Reported as given; not an answer to 'how much do I have'.

fields.label: Amazon Last Updated
fields.description: When Amazon last touched this summary, in site time.

fields.label: Synced At
fields.description: When we last read it. A SKU that has left FBA keeps its final row, and this is what says the figure is stale.

fields.label: Row Key
fields.description: connection::marketplace::seller_sku — what makes a stock row unique.

module: Alaiy Os Connector Amazon Sp Api
name: Amazon FBA Inventory
